meta.title: TripLoop — AI road-trip planner · 24 regions · 7 continents · bilingual EN+ES
meta.description: Describe your trip in one sentence, get a full itinerary in 30 seconds. 60 curated iconic routes across 7 continents: USA (PCH, Route 66), Europe (Spain, Italy Amalfi, Iceland Ring Road, Ireland NC500, Germany Romantic Road, Scotland NC500), Asia (Japan Golden Route), Oceania (Great Ocean Road, NZ), Latin America (Riviera Maya, Carretera Austral, Ruta 40, Machu Picchu), Canada (Icefields Parkway), Africa (Morocco Sahara). AI warnings, budget calc, EV chargers, streaming, WhatsApp bot, offline PWA.

problem.title: Planning a road trip should not be harder than the trip itself.

items.title: Fake drive times, real regret
items.body: That 2h drive is really 6h with traffic and lunch. We use live traffic data so your day plan holds up in real life — no more arriving at the hotel at midnight.

items.title: Prices that don't hide fees
items.body: Hotels, tickets and meals in your currency, taxes included. No spreadsheet math, no checkout surprises. Budget you can actually trust.

items.title: Finally, in Spanish too
items.body: 500M+ Spanish speakers have no serious road-trip planner. Wanderlog and Layla are English-only. TripLoop is bilingual from day one — same experience, your language.

features.title: Everything a first-time visitor needs — nothing that gets in the way.

items.title: AI-generated starting point
items.body: Describe your trip in plain language. Get a customizable 3–14 day California itinerary in under 30 seconds.

items.title: Real driving times with traffic
items.body: Powered by live Google traffic data. LA→SF says 6h because it's 6h — not 2.

items.title: Multi-currency, tax-inclusive
items.body: See prices in USD, EUR, MXN, GBP with California tax already added. No math at checkout.

items.title: Drag & drop everything
items.body: Rearrange stops, swap days, add restaurants. Your trip updates the route in real time.

items.title: Works offline in national parks
items.body: PWA that caches your maps and itinerary. Yosemite has no signal — we planned for that.

items.title: Book activities in one click
items.body: GetYourGuide + Booking.com integration. We earn a small commission, you never pay extra.

cities.title: Starting with the California classics
cities.subtitle: Ready-to-customize itineraries for every kind of traveler.

pricing.title: Free forever. Upgrade only if you want to.
pricing.subtitle: No credit card to start. Cancel anytime.

footer.tagline: The road trip planner built for people flying in — not driving there their whole lives.
